kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتضاعف (form VI)
# نَتَضَاعَفُ (nataḍāʕafu) /na.ta.dˤaː.ʕa.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
# نَتَضَاعَفَ (nataḍāʕafa) /na.ta.dˤaː.ʕa.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
# نَتَضَاعَفْ (nataḍāʕaf) /na.ta.dˤaː.ʕaf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
